offering_description.value: Supplies electricity and natural gas to residential, commercial and industrial customers through regulated utilities in the northwestern United States and Alaska.

primary_services.value: electric transmission and distribution; natural gas distribution

items.detail: Residential electricity and natural gas customers
Commercial and industrial energy users; wholesale energy counterparties
Government facilities and public institutions within utility service territories

end_markets.value: residential energy; commercial buildings; industrial operations; public facilities; wholesale energy

items.detail: Metered electricity and natural gas consumption, delivery charges and recurring utility customer charges
Wholesale electricity and natural gas sales
Operates generating plants, electric networks and gas distribution systems to supply utility customers
Delivers electricity and purchased natural gas to homes, businesses and public facilities
Generates electricity and purchases additional energy for retail supply and wholesale sales

geography_served.detail: Electricity in eastern Washington and northern Idaho; natural gas in Washington, Idaho and Oregon; electricity in Juneau, Alaska through a subsidiary

company_size.value: Established regional utility group with generating plants and extensive electric and natural gas networks across the Pacific Northwest, plus an Alaska utility

specialization.detail: Electric generation, transmission and distribution; natural gas distribution

items.detail: Utility accounts supplied directly through company-operated electric and gas networks; direct wholesale energy transactions

regulatory_exposure.detail: Utility operations and rates are overseen by state utility commissions; interstate electricity activities and hydropower licensing by FERC; environmental and pipeline safety rules also apply

notes: Descriptions rely on model knowledge; current subsidiary ownership and service territories have not been verified.
